source_reasoning.finding: A local find-links entry chosen for a named requirement is a RegistryBuiltWheel, preserving registry distribution kind even though its file location is local.
CachedDist::from_remote maps a Registry BuiltDist to CachedDist::Registry; parsed_url for that variant is None. Path/direct URL distributions use CachedDist::Url instead.
The normal installer derives the optional DirectUrl exclusively from wheel.parsed_url().
The installed .dist-info directory without direct_url.json is parsed as InstalledDistKind::Registry.
Strict satisfaction for Registry sources requires Registry installed kind and the version specifier. It does not require the installed wheel to retain a matching registry index URL.
An already-installed satisfying distribution continues before the registry cache lookup and remote preparation path.

The project uses the original locked resolution, filters virtual projects, and calls the original installer in Strict mode. A registry cache download is unnecessary when the intended Ruff environment is already satisfying.

rejected_assumption.text: A fresh empty UV cache plus a local find-links wheelhouse automatically makes frozen offline sync from a Registry lock install the local wheel.
rejected_assumption.why: The lock's Registry source constructs its original absolute wheel URL and index. Sync builds the flat index separately but does not replace that locked resolution. Registry cache matching requires the original index and wheel filename; a miss retains the original remote dist and original URL. Local flat-index contents are therefore not a guaranteed substitute for the original locked Registry download path.
